content: Mwabhanyambiha bhajinu, wala ngamwalinyambiha mabhete
Bhela itupalika tepani tetubhi na makili kuutola uzaifu wabhu bhanga na makili, wala ngacheitupalika kulinyambiha tabhete.
Kila mundu pachilanda jitu na anyambiha njaki kwa mambu ghambone, nahuli kunchenga mu uhobhalelu.
Kwa ndandi Kristo najombi ngacheakalinyambihi mweni. Nambu ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu, “Matondu ghabhu ghabhukutondwi wehapa ghakambatiki nepani.”
Kwa kubha mambhu ghokapi ghaghalongulili kulembakeka ghakalembakiki kwa ndandi ja kutubhola tepani, nahuli kwa ulendalelu na kwa chiheku cha Malembu Mahuhu tupata kubha na lihobhalelu.
Chapanga joabhi utumbula wa ulendalelu na chiheku, anjangatya mwenga kuholalela chindu chimu mabheti kwa mabheti, kwa kujengalela ulenganesu waka Kristo Yesu,
nahuli kwa mtima ghumu na ndomu ghumu mpata kundumbalila Chapanga, Atati waka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo.
Malobhi Manyahi kwa Bhayahude na kwa bhandu bha mataifa ghangi
Bhela njetanganya mabheti kwa mabheti, ngati najombi Kristo moatujetakalile, nahuli Chapanga alumbalikaje.
Kwa ndandi numpwaghi kubha, Kristo abhi mtumika kwa Bhayahude nahuli kulangiha chakaka jaka Chapanga, na kuilangiha ilanga yela Chapanga yeakabhapekihi akahoko bhitu bha mwande ipata kupitalila.
Kabhete nahuli bhandu bha mataifa ghangi bhundumbalya Chapanga kwa ndandi ja chiha yaki. Ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: “Bhela ananukulumbalya pachilanda ja bhandu bha mataifa ghangi,

content: Kabhete Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha,

content.text: “Muhekalyaje, mwenga bhandu bha mataifa ghangi, muhekalyaje papamu na bhandu bhaka Chapanga.”

content: Kabhete,

content.text: “Munjembila Bambo, mwehapa mabhandu bha mataifa ghangi,

content: Kabhete, mlota Isaya apwagha,

content.text: jombi joanapitalya na kubhatawala bhandu bha mataifa ghangi,

content: Bhela Chapanga wa lihobhalelu antwelakya mwehapa mabhokapi chiheku mu uhobhalelu, mpata kujonjukeka nakanopi kubha na lihobhalelu, kupetela kwa makili ghaka Roho Mhuhu.
Lihengu laka Paulo
Bhalongu bhangu, nepani namwete mi na uchakaka kubha, mwehapa mtwelili wambone, na mtwelakiki umanyi wokapi, kabhete muweza kulakalanila.
Nambu nundembela, kwa makakala nakanopi pandu pa baluwa jenjenu, ngati kunkombukela kabhete, kwa chihomu chela cheambeki Chapanga,

nahuli mya mtumika waka Yesu Kristo pachilanda ja bhandu bha mataifa ghangi. Naghahengilaje lihengu Malobhi Manyahi ghaka Chapanga lihengu la upenganyambiku, nahuli bhandu bha mataifa ghangi bhapata kubha nyambiku jejijetakalewa na Chapanga, jakabya jigholuliki kwa Roho Mhuhu.
Bhela nililumbalila muka Yesu Kristo, kwa utumika wangu palongi jaka Chapanga.
Kwa ndandi nganengi kulongela chindu chengi chokapi kupeta chela Kristo cheahengiki kwa kundumila nepani, nahuli bhandu bha mataifa ghangi bhapata kutii, kwa malobhi ghanalongili na kughahenga,
kwa makili gha nginyulila na ngangachu, na kwa makili ghaka Roho Mhuhu. Na kwa kujenda mwanja kila pandu, kutumbula ku Yelusalemu mbaka ku Iluliko, ndangizi wichu Malobhi Manyahi ghaka Kristo.
Bhela chembala nde kutangaza Malobhi Manyahi, nambu nga pala ambapu Kristo ajomwi kumanyikana, nahuli nganihika kuchenga panani ja luhuli lwaka mundu najonge.
Nambu ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: na bhala bhangakujowana malobhi ghaki, anabhamanyaje.”

content: Paulo apanga kujenda ku Loma
Anana nde ndandi nakahibhalakiki mala pamaheli nganiweza kuhika kwinu.
Nambu kwa kubha sajenu nyomwili lihengu langu upambala ghongone, na kubha kwa hyaka yamaheli mi na chilolu chikolongwa cha kuhika kwinu hoku,

nhobhalela kuhenga bhenibhela sajenu. Nakapaliki kumbona nakabya mumwanja kujenda ku Spania na kupata ujangatilu winu kwa mwanja ghonihoghu ananyomwi kuhekalela kutama kwa chikahi chijipi papamu na mwehapa.
Nambu sajenu nyenda ku Yelusalemu kubhatumakila bhahuhu.
Kwa ndandi ibhanyambihi bhandu bha ku Makedonia na Akaya kubhoha ujangatilu kwa ndandi ja bhahuhu bhabhabhi bhahochu ku Yelusalemu hoku.

Bhombi bheni bhaholali kuhenga bhenibhela, nambu kwa chakaka, leniheli nde lihengu labhu kwa bhanihabha. Kwa ndandi anangati bhandu bha mataifa ghangi bhashiliki nhupu ya kiroho ya Bhayahude, ibhapalika na bhombi kubhajangatila Bhayahude kwa mambu ghabhu gha kihyegha.
Ananyomwi kuhenga lihengu leniheli na kubhapekeha ujangatilu hoghu ghoubhonginwi kwa ndandi jabhu, anambetila kwinu, nakabya mu mwanja kujenda ku Spania.
Nanatu manyi chakaka kubha, panihika kwinu hoku, ananhikaje na mbengalelu jaka Kristo.
Bhela, bhalongu bhangu, numpwaghila kwa lihina laka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo, na kwa upalu waka Roho Mhuhu, mkangamalaje papamu na nepani mu malobhu ghinu kwa ndandi jangu palongi jaka Chapanga.
Mulobhaje mbata kubhoka lukwali kwa bhala bhangakuhobhalela bhabhabhi ku Yudea, na lihengu langu ku Yelusalemu hoku lipata kujetakalewa na bhahuhu bhabhabhi konihoku.
Bhela, Chapanga anaapalike, ananhweza kuhika kwinu hoku kwa mtima wa chiheku, na kupata kupomulela papamu na mwehapa.
Chapanga wa lukwali abya papamu na mwehapa mabhokapi. Amina.
